description: An assessor is due at the Ward Nine permits window at some point today and does not intend to spend her morning standing in a corridor. You will. That is the job and Halcyon is not embarrassed about it.
name: Place Held

objectives.desc: Hold a place in the permits queue until the assessor arrives.
emotes: {who} shuffles forward one place in ninety minutes.
{who} is asked twice what they are queuing for and does not know either time.
